reader.requirement: At --std 85 a page footing report group may begin no higher than integer-5 + 1, integer-5 being FOOTING, or LAST DETAIL when FOOTING is omitted, or PAGE LIMIT when both are omitted (§1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2); a page footing whose absolute first line is at or above integer-5 is refused (SR8e), and a valid one is presented on its LINE NUMBER line.

edition-consulted.switches: year < 2002 changes only the REPORT FOOTING upper limit (Cobol85FinalLineCounter); the PAGE FOOTING arm (Footing + 1, PageLimit) is the same
Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 refuses a relative first LINE in a page footing (§1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR9); 2002+ places it at FOOTING + integer-2

reader.edition-search: grep year|DialectLevel|IsActive in ReportSectionBinder GroupLimits/ScreenReportGroupLines and ReportWriter: PresentPageFooting consults no edition; the FOOTING default (ReportSectionBinder lines 261-265) is edition-agnostic and matches §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2 c-e.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 the first LINE of a page footing must be absolute (SR9), so the upper limit applies to an absolute line only; the FOOTING+1 limit itself is the same
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover LINE = FOOTING refused; not exercised: FOOTING defaulted from LAST DETAIL or PAGE LIMIT, FOOTING+1 accepted and placed, a multi-line footing at the lower limit

probes.printed: error COBOL2199: the absolute line LINE 12 of page footing report group 'PF1' lies above the upper limit 13 (same at --std 2023)

probes.expected: FOOTING 12: page footing starts on 13 = integer-5 + 1

probes.printed: error COBOL2199: LINE 10 ... above the upper limit 11
probes.expected: LAST DETAIL 10, no FOOTING: integer-5 = 10, line 10 refused
LAST DETAIL 10, no FOOTING: line 11 accepted and presented

probes.printed: error COBOL2199: LINE 20 ... above the upper limit 21
probes.expected: no LAST DETAIL/FOOTING: integer-5 = PAGE LIMIT 20, no page footing line possible

probes.printed: error COBOL2199: the relative lines at the end of page footing report group 'PF1' carry its last line to line 21, past the group's lower limit 20
probes.expected: lower limit GR2 at PAGE LIMIT

probes.printed: error COBOL2199: the first LINE clause of a page footing report group is relative (LINE PLUS 2) ... (ISO §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR9)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.9 GR1  (cite.py --check "adding one to the value of integer-5 of the FOOTING phrase")
OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2  (cite.py --check "the value of integer-4 is given to integer-5")
OK  §1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR8e  (cite.py --check "from the line number specified by integer-5 plus 1 to the line number specified by integer-1")
OK  §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR9  (cite.py --check "must be an absolute LINE NUMBER clause")

reader.notes: GroupLimits gives a page footing (Footing + 1, PageLimit) at every edition, and the binder defaults FOOTING exactly as §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2 says. The diagnostics cite §2023 clause numbers at --std 85; the behaviour matches the 1985 text.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 on shapes the reader did not try. refute-1985-04/c5/r5a.cob: PAGE LIMIT 16 HEADING 1 FIRST DETAIL 3 FOOTING 9 with LAST DETAIL omitted (GR2 d: integer-4 takes integer-5), a group-level 'TYPE PF LINE 10' sourcing LINE-COUNTER, 10 details over two pages: page 1 = HEAD, details on lines 3-9, 'PFT1 10' on line 10, form feed; page 2 = HEAD, three details, blank lines 6-9, 'PFT1 10' on line 10 at TERMINATE. The page footing is presented on integer-5 + 1 on every page. r5c.cob: long forms 'PAGE LIMITS ARE 16 LINES' and 'TYPE PAGE FOOTING LINE NUMBER IS 9' with FOOTING 9: refused COBOL2199 'LINE 9 ... above the upper limit 10'; r5d.cob the same with LINE NUMBER IS 10: accepted, identical report. r5b.cob: a page footing in an RD with no PAGE clause is refused (COBOL0899, plus COBOL2199 for its absolute LINE). cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.10.9 GR1 ('adding one to the value of integer-5 of the FOOTING phrase'); OK §1985:XIII.3.8.4 GR2 ('the value of integer-5 is given to integer-4'). Label-only: the diagnostics cite §2023 clauses at --std 85.
